content.description: Illustration showing removal of low coast modulator valve and intermediate modulator valve from valve body assembly

content.text: 7. REMOVE LOW COAST MODULATOR VALVE AND INTERMEDIATE MODULATOR VALVE

content.description: Illustration showing removal of lock-up relay valve by removing the pin and pushing the sleeve

items: (a) Remove the pin by pushing the sleeve.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of sleeve with lock-up relay valve and spring

items: (b) Remove sleeve with lock-up relay valve and spring.

content.description: Illustration showing placement of mark on bevel of primary regulator valve and spring retainer positioning

content.text: 9. REMOVE SPRING RETAINER FROM PRIMARY REGULATOR VALVE
WARNING: Highly compressed spring inside — keep away from face.

items: (a) Place a mark on the bevel when the retainer is positioned.

content.text: NOTE: When reassembling, position the retainer in the same position.

content.description: Illustration showing pressing on valve sleeve to remove spring retainer while holding valve body face down

items: (b) To remove the retainer, hold the valve body face down, and press in on the valve sleeve. The retainer will drop out. Slowly relieve spring tension.
